verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the MCP tools reference, which lists 'project templates' as a searchable object type. This shows Asana has project templates as a first-party entity, but nothing documents pre-built templates or creating a new project from one. Missing for 10: documentation of a pre-built template gallery, a documented flow for instantiating a project from a template, PM-oriented template content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Searches tasks, projects, project templates, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields, and AI Teammates by name.
